Notes qa) M, values which are followed by an asterisk "*" have been derived from macroseismic data. The M, value in brackets has a low
reliability according to its original source.
(2) For M, values which have been re-calculated using the Prague formula, the number of data sets n used in the calculations and the
standard deviation S.D. of the calculated M, values are also given in this table.
(3) M values followed by letters b and L are body-wave magnitudes and local magnitudes respectively. For the unqualified M value,
the magnitude scale has not been given in the original source.
(4) R; values are given for earthquakes for which an isoseismal map can be found. For each isoseismal, the R; value has been taken
to be the radius of a circle with an area equal to that bounded by the isoseismal.
(5) The earthquakes of 1520 May, 1571 Jun 05, 1895 Feb, 1922 May 20 and 1936 Apr 23 given in this Table are found to have been

based on incorrect information by the Guangdong Bureau of Seismology and have now been deleted from their earthquake database.
